prompts.text:
You recently had a new washing machine delivered, but it does not work properly.

Write a letter to the shop manager. In your letter:
• describe the problem
• explain what happened when you contacted the shop
• say what you would like the shop to do

Begin your letter: Dear Sir or Madam,
points: describe the problem
explain what happened when you contacted the shop
say what you want the shop to do

prompts.text:
A friend from another country is coming to visit your town for a week.

Write a letter to your friend. In your letter:
• suggest places to visit
• explain what the weather will be like
• say what your friend should bring

Begin your letter: Dear ...,
points: suggest places to visit
describe the weather
say what to bring

prompts.text:

points: explain why
suggest how your work will be covered
say when you will return

prompts.text:
More and more people are working from home instead of going to an office.

Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

Some people think that children should help with household chores from a young age. Others believe children should spend their free time on study and play.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.

Many small local shops are closing because people prefer to shop online.

What problems does this cause? What can be done to help local shops? Write at least 250 words.

In many countries, people are now working until a much older age than before.

Is this a positive or negative development? Write at least 250 words.

Some people think that public transport in cities should be free for everyone.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

Many children now have their own mobile phone before the age of ten.

Do you think this is a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

Some people believe that young people should go to university after school, while others think it is better to start work and gain experience.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

Some people prefer to live in a big city, while others prefer to live in the countryside.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

In many countries, a large amount of food is thrown away by shops and households every day.

Why does this happen? What can be done to reduce food waste?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

In many countries, more and more older people live alone and feel lonely.

What are the causes of this problem? What solutions can you suggest?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

More and more people are moving to another country to work.

Do the advantages of working abroad outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

Large shopping centres are replacing small local shops in many towns.

What are the advantages and disadvantages of this?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
